fields.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Yunara''' launches a spinning prayer bead in the target direction that briefly grants {{tip|sight}} of its {{tt|surroundings|Cannot see through terrain nor brush}} as it travels. The bead slows down significantly while colliding with an enemy, lingering as it travels and resetting its remaining duration; upon reaching maximum range, it will expand and linger in place for 1 second regardless of enemies hit.

The initial hit against each enemy before the bead's expansion deals {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 99% decaying over {{fd|1.5}} seconds. While lingering, the bead deals {{#expr:{{#var:lm}}*100/4}}% of the impact damage as {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies every {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
fields.description2: ''Arc of Judgment'' deals {{pp|50 to 100 for 3|1;9;13|key=%}} damage against {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|execute|executes}} them if they would be killed by 6 more damage instances from the linger effect.
fields.notes:
* Applies {{tip|area damage}} for the initial hit and {{tip|persistent area damage}} for the lingering effect.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} can block either the initial hit or one damage tick of the lingering effect.{{Effect at cast time end}}
* ''Arc of Judgment'' can hit an enemy more than once with the initial damage as well with the lingering effect (both while not expanded and while expanded).
** The bead can hit an enemy multiple times if they collide with it again while it is in flight.
